description: Source code for ChartRenderer class in MigraDoc library, responsible for rendering chart images into RTF documents, including image processing, dimension calculations, and RTF byte encoding.

classes.name: ChartRenderer
classes.description: Sealed class responsible for rendering chart objects into RTF format, handling image creation, dimension settings, and byte encoding.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to render the chart as an image into RTF, managing temporary files and rendering context.

methods.name: RenderImage
methods.description: Handles rendering of image attributes and byte series into RTF.

methods.name: StartImageDescription
methods.description: Begins the RTF description of the image, depending on inline or block context.

methods.name: EndImageDescription
methods.description: Ends the RTF image description block.

methods.name: RenderImageAttributes
methods.description: Renders image properties such as shape type, fill, dimensions, and source type.

methods.name: RenderSourceType
methods.description: Specifies the image source type in RTF (PNG).

methods.name: RenderDimensionSettings
methods.description: Sets scaling, width, and height attributes for the image in RTF.

methods.name: StoreTempImage
methods.description: Creates an image file from the chart, using GDI+ or other graphics context, for embedding into RTF.

methods.name: RenderByteSeries
methods.description: Reads the image file and encodes it as a hexadecimal byte series for RTF embedding.

methods.name: GetShapeHeight
methods.description: Calculates the shape height including line width.

methods.name: GetShapeWidth
methods.description: Calculates the shape width including line width.
